newsitem.title: ROMANIA: First-tier stocks keep Bucharest trade active.
newsitem.headline: First-tier stocks keep Bucharest trade active.

text.p: The Bucharest bourse's two first-tier stocks traded actively on Wednesday, keeping turnover close to the previous level at 2.6 billion lei.
Chemical plant Oltchim and Azomures fertiliser maker had combined turnover of 2.4 billion lei.
"Buying interest in both heavyweights remained high, though supply slightly overran demand in the case of Azomures, depressing its price," a trader said.
Azomures shed 50 lei to close at 1,620, while Oltchim ended the session 90 lei stronger at 1,300.
Policolor dye maker and pharmaceuticals company Terapia were the most actively traded second-tier stocks, both moving into positive territory.
Policolor closed 60 lei higher at 1,640 and Terapia gained 200 lei to close at 2,300.

"I expect volumes in Terapia, today at its second session, to grow sensibly in the future," said a broker. "For the time being, many traders consider its quote high compared with 1,000 lei at par, but this is the real price of this stock."
Most other prices on the second tier drifted lower or stayed flat and five stocks had no trade.
Newcomer Grimex SA, a mining equipment company, had no trade and brokers said that was a result of a huge gap between bid and ask quotes.
"Shareholders stubbornly offered Grimex shares at 25,000 lei each, which is their face value, while buyers stuck to their 3,500 lei maximum bids," a trader said.
Three companies remained suspended pending announcements on their recent shareholders' meetings.

Two unofficial indices -- the VAB and the BIG -- dropped from the previous session by 0.3 and 0.47 percent respectively. The BIG first-tier index was 1,593.26 points, 2.7 percent down on the previous session.
